title: A Generous Offer
summary: A letter with a green wax seal: someone wants to meet you on the road. Blackwater has heard you're the kind of hero who can be talked to. Hear the offer. Take it, or refuse it in a way they'll remember.

goals.say: The recruiter waits for your answer, smiling.

threats.name: Blackwater Recruiter
talk: Grow for us. Sell for us. Get stupid rich. We already pay those gold-eyed bastards their cut; you'd just be paying yourself.
Because you're not a fucking saint. Saints don't get letters from us. You did.
Then we're enemies, and you'd better be very fucking good at it.

spare.label: Take the job
spare.line: 'Wise. The Fixer will find you. Bring a sample.'

quest_book.title: A Generous Offer
quest_book.author: A friend in the valley
pages:
We've been watching you.

You are not like the other heroes. You understand that the world is not clean.

Meet our man on the road and hear what we have to offer. You'll find him near wherever you read this.

- B.
